comment.text: BCOR N1459 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bowel tumors; Lung tumors; Ovarian tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: ovaryfallopiantube; Unspecified tumor site. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting BCOR residue N1459 have been observed in uterine tumors, lung tumors, and ovarian tumors.
